SAGA-EUR.summary: SAGA faces clustered venue removals: Bitget is scheduled to delist SAGA/USDT on September 24, 2026, following recent SAGA pair removals at Binance, Phemex, and CoinEx. This creates immediate liquidity/market-access risk.
materialRisks: Bitget plans to delist SAGA/USDT on September 24, 2026; deposits are already suspended and open orders will be cancelled at delisting. ([bitgetapp.com](https://www.bitgetapp.com/id/support/articles/12560603895618?utm_source=openai))

Recent multi-venue pair removals materially increase the risk of fragmented liquidity and abrupt venue-specific order-book changes: Binance removed SAGA/FDUSD on September 11, Phemex delisted SAGA/USDT on September 4, and CoinEx began SAGA delisting procedures on September 8. ([binance.bh](https://www.binance.bh/en-KZ/support/announcement/detail/b9198262dd5f4071a1119b9f52cbe00c?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The identified asset is likely Saga Protocol's SAGA token, but the specific SAGA-EUR execution venue was not supplied; the cited actions directly concern other quote pairs/venues.
Saga's public status page reported no outages or incidents through September 10, 2026; this does not offset the exchange-access risk.
A third-party unlock tracker lists the next SAGA unlock for October 9, 2026, rather than within the immediate 24-hour window.
